definitions: The political philosophy of Niccolò Machiavelli, especially as it relates to the use of cunning and deceitful tactics in politics.
The use of cunning and deceitful tactics in general, especially in politics or in order to achieve power.
A personality trait characterized by a manipulative, cynical, and amoral approach to others.
examples: His Machiavellianism was evident in his rise to power.
The novel explores themes of Machiavellianism and betrayal.
Some leaders are criticised for their Machiavellianism.
